title: KHR_audio_rigid_bodies Acoustic Surface
description: The microscopic finish of a surface, which determines the sound of sustained contact against it.

spectralSlope.description: Exponent of the one-dimensional roughness power spectrum as a function of spatial frequency. The Hurst exponent is -(1 + spectralSlope) / 2 and the profile's fractal dimension is spectralSlope / 2 + 2.5.

shortWavelength.description: Shortest wavelength the roughness spectrum carries, in meters. Defaults to `correlationLength` / 16.
shortWavelength.gltf_detailedDescription: The fine end of the band the surface is described over, as `correlationLength` is its coarse end. A self-affine surface has no shortest wavelength of its own and both spectral moments diverge without one, so the density of asperities and the radius of curvature at one exist only against a stated cutoff. Leaving this coarse describes the surface over a narrower band rather than making it smoother: the roughness below the cutoff is still present, standing inside the contacts that bear the load.

waviness.description: Root-mean-square height of the surface's departure from flat above the finish, in meters.
waviness.gltf_detailedDescription: With `wavinessLength` this gives the ratio deciding how much of a shared area two nominally flat faces bear over. It MUST be the longer and gentler of the two scales: `wavinessLength` greater than `correlationLength`, and `waviness` / `wavinessLength` less than `roughness` / `correlationLength`. Zero leaves the surface flat above its finish, bearing over the whole shared area, which spreads the load over more asperities than can turn over and renders nearly silent.

wavinessLength.description: Lateral extent of the surface's departure from flat above the finish, in meters.

profile.description: The index of the accessor of measured surface heights along a track, in meters, relative to the mean plane. The accessor type MUST be "SCALAR", the component type MUST be FLOAT, and the count MUST be at least 2.
profile.gltf_detailedDescription: A stored profile makes the rendered result reproducible across implementations. When absent, an implementation synthesizes a profile from `roughness`, `correlationLength`, and `spectralSlope`, which specifies the surface statistically rather than exactly.

sampleSpacing.description: Distance along the surface between consecutive `profile` samples, in meters.

normalTexture.description: A tangent-space normal map describing the surface's mesoscale structure, the visible bumpiness between the collision geometry and the statistical roughness.
normalTexture.gltf_detailedDescription: Sampled along the contact path using the referenced texture coordinate set of the contacted mesh primitive. Interpreted exactly as the glTF 2.0 core material `normalTexture`, including `scale`. When absent, the contacted primitive's material `normalTexture` applies, taking its `index`, `texCoord`, and `scale` together, so the sound correlates with the visible surface without the author restating the reference. Set this only to override that correspondence.

material.description: The index of the acoustic material in the top level `acousticMaterials` array giving the bulk elastic properties of this surface.
material.gltf_detailedDescription: Supplies the contact stiffness. When absent, the material of the node's modal model applies, which leaves the contact stiffness undetermined for a node that instances no modal model.
